regulation: Besluit beheer verpakkingen — Afvalfonds Verpakkingen / Verpact
title: Netherlands: packaging waste contribution above 50,000 kg
summary: A business placing more than 50,000 kg of packaging on the Dutch market in a year must report to and pay the waste management contribution to Verpact (formerly Afvalfonds Verpakkingen). Below that weight the contribution does not apply, though other packaging duties may.
